title: What happens if you ignore low fuel?
hook: Most drivers ignore the fuel light.

script.narration: Most drivers ignore the fuel light. Pushing your car to run on nearly empty isn't just risky; it can actually damage your fuel pump. Modern fuel pumps rely on gasoline to stay cool and lubricated while they operate.
When you consistently run low, the pump sucks in sediment from the bottom of the tank and can overheat without enough fuel to surround it. This leads to costly repairs that are entirely avoidable.
